<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="QPZYC5GyVwmzWxNb8bLe"> <mxGraphModel dx="1272" dy="651" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "
@startuml
title PGI Campus Guard - Client Server Architecture

skinparam componentStyle rectangle
skinparam shadowing false

package \"Client Layer\" {
 [Student Mobile App\n(Flutter / Kotlin)] as Mobile
 [Admin Web Dashboard\n(Next.js)] as Admin
 [QR Scanner\n(Gate Security)] as Scanner
}

package \"Server Layer\" {
 [Python Backend\n(FastAPI)] as API
 [Authentication & Authorization\n(JWT + RBAC)] as Auth
 [QR Validation\n& Access Control] as QR
 [Entry / Exit Management] as Access
 [Occupancy Management] as Occupancy
 [AI Anomaly Detection\n(Isolation Forest)] as AI
}

database \"PostgreSQL Database\" as DB

Mobile --> API : HTTPS / REST API
Admin --> API : HTTPS / REST API
Scanner --> API : QR Scan Request

API --> Auth : Verify User
API --> QR : Validate Dynamic QR
API --> Access : Record Entry / Exit
API --> Occupancy : Update Occupancy
API --> AI : Analyze Access Logs

Auth --> DB : User & Role Data
QR --> DB : QR Validation Data
Access --> DB : Access Records
Occupancy --> DB : Occupancy Data
AI --> DB : Access Log Data

AI --> API : Anomaly Score
API --> Admin : Suspicious Activity Alerts

@enduml
",
 "config": null

 "data": "
@startuml
title PGI Campus Guard - Layered Architecture

skinparam componentStyle rectangle
skinparam shadowing false
top to bottom direction

package \"1. Presentation Layer\" {
 [Student Mobile Application\n(Flutter / Kotlin)]
 [Admin Dashboard\n(Next.js)]
 [Gate QR Scanner Interface]
}

package \"2. Application Layer\" {
 [Authentication Management]
 [QR Code Management]
 [Entry / Exit Management]
 [User Management]
 [Occupancy Management]
 [Alert Management]
}

package \"3. Business Logic Layer\" {
 [JWT Authentication]
 [Role Based Access Control]
 [Dynamic QR Validation]
 [Duplicate Scan Prevention]
 [Access Rules Validation]
 [Isolation Forest\nAnomaly Detection]
}

package \"4. Data Access Layer\" {
 [Database Operations]
 [Access Log Repository]
 [User Repository]
 [QR Record Repository]
}

database \"5. Database Layer\nPostgreSQL\" as DB

[Student Mobile Application\n(Flutter / Kotlin)] --> [Authentication Management]
[Admin Dashboard\n(Next.js)] --> [User Management]
[Gate QR Scanner Interface] --> [QR Code Management]

[Authentication Management] --> [JWT Authentication]
[User Management] --> [Role Based Access Control]
[QR Code Management] --> [Dynamic QR Validation]
[Entry / Exit Management] --> [Duplicate Scan Prevention]
[Entry / Exit Management] --> [Access Rules Validation]
[Occupancy Management] --> [Access Rules Validation]
[Alert Management] --> [Isolation Forest\nAnomaly Detection]

[JWT Authentication] --> [User Repository]
[Dynamic QR Validation] --> [QR Record Repository]
[Duplicate Scan Prevention] --> [Access Log Repository]
[Isolation Forest\nAnomaly Detection] --> [Access Log Repository]

[User Repository] --> DB
[QR Record Repository] --> DB
[Access Log Repository] --> DB

@enduml

 "data": "
@startuml
title PGI Campus Guard - Module Dependency Component Diagram

skinparam componentStyle rectangle
skinparam shadowing false
left to right direction

package \"Frontend Modules\" {
 [Student Module] as Student
 [Admin Module] as Admin
 [QR Scanner Module] as Scanner
}

package \"Backend Modules\" {
 [Authentication Module] as Auth
 [User Management Module] as User
 [QR Generation Module] as QRGen
 [QR Validation Module] as QRVal
 [Access Records Module] as Records
 [Occupancy Module] as Occupancy
 [Anomaly Detection Module] as AI
 [Alert Module] as Alert
}

package \"Data Layer\" {
 database \"PostgreSQL\" as DB
}

Student --> Auth
Student --> QRGen
Student --> Records

Admin --> Auth
Admin --> User
Admin --> Records
Admin --> Occupancy
Admin --> Alert

Scanner --> QRVal

QRGen --> Auth
QRVal --> Auth
QRVal --> Records
QRVal --> DB

Records --> DB
User --> DB
Auth --> DB

Records --> Occupancy
Records --> AI
AI --> Alert
Alert --> Admin

@enduml
